description.value: The Kicking Horse Day Lodge is the base-area hub at Kicking Horse Mountain Resort near Golden, BC, home to the Whitetooth Grill — a casual counter-service spot offering pizza, sandwiches, salads, snacks, and cold beer. The resort is a major mountain bike destination with a full bike park, rentals, and lessons, making the Day Lodge a natural stop for riders. The venue also hosts après-ski live music events on weekends.
